ideas.pitch: A wireless-controlled sumo robot system enhanced with a low-latency ESP32-CAM and TinyML module for automated edge-detection and counter-maneuvers.
ideas.title: SumoVision: Edge-AI Autonomous Counter-Tactics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical robotics with edge AI processing, following the pattern of building an unusual physical build that stands out in a room.

ideas.pitch: A high-torque, custom-geared motor driver firmware and telemetry dashboard ensuring maximum pushing traction within the 48V DC robot limit.
ideas.title: TractionKing: Dual-Motor Skid-Steer Power Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on raw mechanical and hardware engineering difficulty, matching the winning pattern of genuinely hard engineering.

ideas.pitch: A redundant hardware and software emergency stop system guaranteeing instant motor cutoff to comply with safety regulations while preventing RF signal interference.
ideas.title: KillSwitch-X: Fail-Safe Wireless Interlock
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical compliance and safety measures that judges prioritize in high-speed, high-power combat robotics.

ideas.pitch: An array of high-speed time-of-flight distance sensors that automatically overrides operator inputs to prevent the robot from accidentally reversing out of the ring boundary.
ideas.title: ArenaMap: Ultrasonic Perimeter Proximity Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a robust, live-demonstrable mechanical assist system that directly targets the win condition of staying inside the circular arena.

ideas.pitch: A specialized low-latency first-person video transmission setup with tactical telemetry overlay to give the single operator a competitive edge in 2-minute matches.
ideas.title: TeleSumo: Low-Latency FPV Cockpit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an impressive, working live demo that directly impacts usability and operator performance during high-intensity matches.
